jobs.title: Drift Wood #26 · the dumpster
jobs.prompt: a four-panel comic strip laid out as a two-by-two grid on a half page, thin black panel borders (4 panels). Style: black and white comic strip panel, scratchy crow-quill pen and ballpoint ink on cardstock, harsh photocopy contrast, heavy black spotting, jagged uneven line weights, 1990s indie comix zine style, xerox grain, no color, no gray tones. Cast, drawn the same in every panel, ages exactly as given: WOOD — aged 18, gaunt boy drawn a head too tall, oversized thrift-store wool overcoat to the knee worn indoors, faded black tee, dark jeans, sneakers, a bristol pad clutched flat to his chest, chin up; GULLY — aged 19, stocky boy with a round face, backwards blue cap, faded green hoodie with his hands in the front pocket, muddy tan work boots, easy slouch. Title of the strip: DRIFT WOOD. The strip: A December night behind the bowling alley. Nothing tied there yet. The strip goes and looks anyway. Panel 1: a small-town bowling alley at night from across the highway, its neon sign fully lit, two teenagers crossing the parking lot, one with a bowling bag, black and white with heavy blacks (in this panel: WOOD, GULLY). Panel 2: two teenagers behind a bowling alley at night, one stopped and looking at a rusted dumpster beside a chain-link fence under a bare bulb (in this panel: WOOD, GULLY). Panel 3: close-up of a teenage boy drawing a rusted dumpster on a pad braced against a chain-link fence at night under a bare bulb (in this panel: WOOD). Panel 4: inside a bowling alley, a boy in a backwards cap bowling in the middle distance while a boy in an overcoat sits in the plastic seats drawing, black and white, no words (in this panel: GULLY, WOOD). No text, no lettering, no speech balloons, no signature; leave clean space in each panel where balloons would go. Reference @gully_17 is the model sheet for GULLY: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Reference @chloe_17 is the model sheet for CHLOE: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Reference @wood_20 is the model sheet for WOOD: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Match the attached references: @gully_17 for the character the strip's Gully at 17; @chloe_17 for the character the strip's Chloe at 17; @wood_20 for the character Wood at 20-23.
